title: Approve the composition
question: Three compositions of the category-standard landing page. Which one should the build match?

options.label: Headline-led
options.thesis: Centered claim, the fan in a bar below it, three equal offer cards, a specs strip.
options.viewport: Nav; centered headline Your logo, floating in mid-air; subline; Request a quote and See it in the wild; wide photo of the fan on a bar wall with a floating bottle; three cards Fan + cover $250, Content $150, Tripod $99; specs strip.
options.risk: The most familiar arrangement of the three; it wins on recognition and loses on memory.

options.label: Product-led
options.thesis: The fan itself at life scale is the first viewport; the claim sits under it.
options.viewport: Nav; the 42 cm fan straight on filling the screen with a floating donut in front of the hub; callouts to rotor, LEDs and cover; headline bottom-left, Request a quote bottom-right; specs strip; How it works begins below.
options.risk: Prices drop below the fold; the visitor sees the machine before the offer.

options.label: Offer-led
options.thesis: The quote builder is the hero: three tiles with tick boxes and a running total.
options.viewport: Nav; headline Everything you need to float your logo; three tall tiles Fan + cover, Content, Tripod with photos and tick boxes; sticky summary with total and Request a quote; In the wild begins below.
options.risk: Reads as a configurator before the visitor has seen the picture float; proof comes second.
